select s.sheet_id, s.sheet_title, s.lesson_id, s.creator_id, s.dept_id, s.status, s.max_pages, s.teacher_machine_ip, s.is_public, s.create_by, s.create_time, s.update_by, s.update_time, u.nick_name as creator_name, COALESCE( (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.student_id) FROM biz_guide_sheet_answer a WHERE a.sheet_id = s.sheet_id AND a.status = '2'), 0 ) as submitted_count, COALESCE( (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT st.student_id) FROM biz_guide_sheet_assignment sa INNER JOIN biz_student st ON sa.class_code COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci = st.class_code COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci AND sa.entry_year COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci = st.entry_year WHERE sa.sheet_id = s.sheet_id), 0 ) as total_assigned, COALESCE( (SELECT ROUND(AVG(a.total_score), 1) FROM biz_guide_sheet_answer a WHERE a.sheet_id = s.sheet_id AND a.status = '2' AND a.total_score IS NOT NULL), 0 ) as avg_score from biz_guide_sheet s left join sys_user u on s.creator_id = u.user_id
and s.sheet_title like concat('%', #{sheetTitle}, '%') and s.lesson_id = #{lessonId} and s.dept_id = #{deptId} and s.creator_id = #{creatorId} and s.status = #{status} and (s.is_public = 'Y' or s.creator_id = #{params.currentUserId})
order by s.create_time desc
